'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Brian Hunter LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' Echo Base Operations
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
